It also says an absent return establishes neither non-performance nor an undecidable evaluation. So P2 is recorded as an absent slot with unconfirmed performance and no invented verdict.

The overall result applies FOUNDATIONS.md Result conjunction. Rule 1 does not apply because there is no authenticated falsification. Rule 2 does not apply because there is no invalid_basis or out_of_frame judgment. Rule 3 applies because of an undecidable predicate (P1) and a missing evaluation (P2), so the result is indeterminate. Both residuals are retained alongside the verdict.
